author: claude
description: Flat building terrace for hilly terrain. A bottom-rounded dirt RoundedCuboid fills below the walking plane and gets a grass cap. A bottom-rounded air RoundedCuboid carves the slope above it. The result has a curved scoop instead of a boxy notch. The flat floor is the central (width-2*radius) x (length-2*radius) rectangle, so keep buildings inside it. Place at the min corner (x, z) with y = the desired walking plane. The fill reaches fill_height+1 blocks below the walking plane, and the carve reaches carve_height blocks above it. Pick carve_height to clear the highest terrain in the footprint. Place the terrace first, then build on it with a separate placement, because the carve step erases any structure inside its volume. Default 31x25 radius 6 gives a 19x13 flat floor.
name: hillside_terrace
